components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Shared chestnut primary action with a clear keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2); min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; font: 600 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--font-body); transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Homepage Primary Button
components.description: Homepage-only pill CTA with a warm gradient and a soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-home-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-6); border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8a5a34, #6b4a2f); color: #fff; font: 600 var(--text-base)/1.2 var(--font-body); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(90, 55, 30, 0.25); transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition); } .ds-btn-home-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7a4f2d, #5a3a22); } .ds-btn-home-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-home-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font: 600 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--font-body); transition: background var(--transition), border-color var(--transition); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-surface-offset); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Registration field with a warm border and explicit focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; transition: border-color var(--transition); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(125, 90, 60, 0.3); border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact pill label; semantic colors distinguish status.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-1); padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-primary-highlight); color: var(--color-primary-active); font: 600 var(--text-xs)/1.3 var(--font-body); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Paper-toned container for grouped lesson or account content.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: var(--space-5); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 var(--space-2); font: 600 var(--text-lg)/1.15 var(--font-display); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-text-muted); font: 400 var(--text-sm)/1.6 var(--font-body); }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Muted, horizontally spaced links beneath a translucent sticky header.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-5); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.4 var(--font-body); color: var(--color-text-muted); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--transition); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--color-text); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }

narrative.overview:
ZarifÇözüm's interface pairs warm paper-like surfaces with cocoa text and chestnut actions. The intended feeling is warm, calm, and trustworthy: clear enough for study, with a quietly editorial character rather than a cold technology aesthetic. The existing ZarifÇözüm logo remains part of the identity.

The shared stylesheet and homepage have related but distinct implementations. Shared page display headings use Clash Display and a restrained chestnut palette; the homepage switches its headings to a Georgia-led serif, softens surfaces, and uses pill-shaped calls to action. Preserve those as observed surface variations rather than flattening them into one invented component style.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream and cocoa form the visual foundation.
Serif display type and sans-serif reading text create the main hierarchy.
Rounded controls, paper-toned cards, and soft ambient shadows keep the interface approachable.
New work is mobile-first and favors clear, breathable layouts.

rules.name: The Warm Paper Rule
rules.body: Keep the cream-and-cocoa identity recognizable across surfaces; distinguish page-specific token overrides instead of silently normalizing them.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep the serif homepage display and the shared Clash Display heading stack as distinct existing roles; do not apply the homepage override globally without an explicit redesign.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use a soft shadow to clarify a surface or interaction state, never as a dark decorative effect.

dos: Do preserve the existing ZarifÇözüm logo and cream/chestnut identity.
Do build new surfaces mobile-first and leave enough breathing room around learning content.
Do use mathematics-themed hand-drawn illustrations such as rulers, set squares, and graph paper when useful.
Do use subtle, purposeful animation and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do keep color variants and typography overrides scoped to the surfaces where the code currently uses them.
donts: Don't shift the product into a cold blue-purple technology aesthetic.
Don't use hard dark shadows, neon colors, or crowded, high-density layouts.
Don't use success, warning, error, or live colors as decorative substitutes for the warm brand palette.
Don't flatten the homepage's serif and pill-button treatment into every shared page without an explicit redesign.
